One structure. One way of running every market. The infrastructure is in place. Now we want to put AI to work inside it. The role Title: AI Lead Reports to: Group CEO Location: Dubai or Cairo, with regular time in our other markets Type: Full time You will be our first AI hire. The mandate is simple: take the Studio, our costing and our client service to a different level using AI. Not a lab. Not a pilot deck. Working tools used every day by designers, estimators and account managers. You will not build alone or in a corner. You build with the people who do the work today, and you make them better at it. You get a tools budget, direct access to the CEO and the authority to change how things are done. What you will do Three places to start. 1.   Studio. Our designers across 9 markets brief, concept, adapt, localise and version work all day. Put AI into that flow: briefing, concepting, adaptation across markets and languages, asset management. Give every country manager a live view of what their designer is working on and how utilised they are. Less repetitive work, more ideas. 2.   Costing. Clean job, cost and pricing data in the ERP, so the tools have something to learn from. •    Buy before build. Pick tools, negotiate them, plug them into what we already have. Build only where nothing fits. •    Set the rules. Client IP, data security, what goes into which model and what never does. •    Train people. Designers, estimators, account managers. Measure adoption, not demos. •    Report results to the CEO every month: hours saved, margin protected, turnaround cut. Not for you if •    You want to research models rather than put them to work. •    You need a big team before you can start. You get a tools budget and the CEO's backing. The team comes with results. •    Nobody outside your own function has ever used something you built. •    You think the hard part is the technology. Here the hard part is 1,200 people changing how they work.
